scope: Selected generated C# single-envelope scalar-element profiles; native positive wire/value contract only. Native repeat/ST03 policies are broader and not claimed as negative parity.

version_wire.message: X12 envelope versions do not match the selected profile.

repetition_wire.message: Repeated X12 element values are outside the selected profile.

repetition_unknown_wire.message: Repeated X12 element values are outside the selected profile.

configured_syntax.message: Configured separators do not match ISA.

bad_isa11.message: X12 separators must be distinct ASCII punctuation; the segment terminator may be LF.

output_isa11.message: ISA11 must match the selected repetition separator.

output_repetition.message: X12 scalar contains an unrepresentable delimiter.

st03.message: X12 envelope element counts are invalid.

controls.message: X12 trailer counts or controls do not match the interchange.

output_rep_missing.message: Modern X12 output requires a selected repetition separator.

descriptor_schema_version.message: Envelope schema versions must agree with the selected X12 profile.

descriptor_rep_width.message: Modern X12 repetition metadata requires one character.

descriptor_rep_delimiter.message: Modern X12 repetition metadata must be distinct ASCII punctuation.

descriptor_fixed_isa11.message: Fixed ISA11 does not agree with the selected modern repetition syntax.

descriptor_fixed_isa16.message: Fixed ISA16 does not agree with the selected modern component syntax.

legacy_rep_width.message: Inactive X12 repetition metadata requires one character.

legacy_version_wire.message: Only the 00401/004010 envelope without element repetition is supported.

option-version.reason: retained interchange version must agree with fixed ISA12

missing-target-repetition.reason: modern output requires a selected repetition separator

noncanonical-group.reason: ISA12 and GS08 require an exact supported fixed version pair

missing-schema-version.reason: ISA12 and GS08 require an exact supported fixed version pair

st03.reason: envelope elements require their exact width and String type

fixed-isa11-conflict.reason: modern fixed ISA11 must agree with the distinct selected repetition separator

fixed-isa11-empty.reason: modern fixed ISA11 must agree with the distinct selected repetition separator

fixed-isa16-conflict.reason: modern fixed ISA16 must agree with the selected component separator

fixed-isa16-empty.reason: modern fixed ISA16 must agree with the selected component separator

ordering: Descriptor and schema admission before syntax; modern ISA12 agreement and physical delimiter qualification before tokenization; repeated wire content before envelope/schema/mapping; mapping before output lexical/completion; final output controls/counts retained.
native_lf_policy: LF source qualification uses auto-discovery only; the native explicit syntax/writer API refuses LF. Generated LF writing retains its established contract.
output_defaults: For modern output only, missing/null/empty ISA11 materializes selected repetition (default ^ when the separator set is absent). ISA16 retains the supplied/fixed requirement. Nonempty values are never overwritten.
fixed_syntax: Explicit fixed ISA11/ISA16, including empty literals, must agree with the selected modern physical syntax before generation/runtime admission. This differs from a missing or empty caller ISA11 value.
version_selection: Each selected side independently requires its declared fixed canonical pair. Adapters do not convert or rewrite versions; an explicit graph may construct another admitted target version.
rust_api: Existing generated Rust typed/JSON APIs are unchanged; its authored compiled host uses the native X12 boundary externally. No generated Rust raw-X12 companion is selected.
